sources.name: AI explanation
sources.notes: Uses the signed-in Claude CLI by default (a free or paid plan; no API key). Switch the service to ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini or Muse, or set an API key and switch the transport to the HTTP API.

sources.name: AI synonyms and antonyms
sources.notes: Uses the signed-in Claude CLI by default (a free or paid plan; no API key). Switch the service to ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini or Muse, or set an API key and switch the transport to the HTTP API.

sources.name: AI translation
sources.notes: Uses the signed-in Claude CLI by default (a free or paid plan; no API key). Switch the service to ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini or Muse, or set an API key and switch the transport to the HTTP API.

sources.name: Oxford English Dictionary
sources.notes: Subscription site; free access only returns search snippets. Enter an OED Researcher API credential (app_id:app_key) for full entries.

sources.name: Google Translate
sources.notes: The key-less endpoint rate-limits after a handful of requests; add a Cloud Translation API key for steady use.

sources.name: DeepL
sources.notes: Disabled by default: the free endpoint rate-limits quickly. Add a DeepL API key, then enable.

drivers.label: Local file
drivers.description: A dictionary file in the app's local storage: kaikki/wiktextract JSONL, FreeDict TEI, CC-CEDICT, ECDICT CSV, Unihan, dictd, TSV or an index built by 'omababel data install'.

drivers.label: Duden
drivers.description: German spelling, meanings, grammar, origin and synonyms from duden.de.

drivers.label: Merriam-Webster
drivers.description: English definitions (and synonyms/antonyms in thesaurus rows) from merriam-webster.com; optional dictionaryapi.com key.

drivers.label: Oxford English Dictionary
drivers.description: OED entries. Free access only yields search snippets; enter an OED Researcher API credential as 'app_id:app_key' for full senses.

drivers.label: Thesaurus.com
drivers.description: English synonyms and antonyms from thesaurus.com.

drivers.label: Google Translate
drivers.description: Full text translation (any language). Optional Cloud Translation API key; without it the public web endpoint is used.

drivers.label: DeepL
drivers.description: Full text translation. Uses the official API when a key is set (free keys end in ':fx'), otherwise the web app's endpoint.

drivers.label: AI service
drivers.description: Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini or Muse. Uses the service's signed-in CLI by default (a free or paid plan, no API key); an API key can be used instead.
drivers.key_hint: API key – only needed for the API transport

drivers.label: Custom URL
drivers.description: Any web page or JSON API. Use {word} in the URL (plus {from} and {to} for translators); the page's readable text is shown.
drivers.key_hint: Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' and as {key} in the URL
